XY: 14-pixel cells from origin0; absolute point ((x+.5)/W,(y+.5)/H,0); relative ((x+.5)/14-gx-.5,(y+.5)/14-gy-.5,0); centers ((gx+.5)*14/W,(gy+.5)*14/H,0)
XYZ: provider XYZ/scale exactly once; floor(XYZ_normalized/.5); absolute normalized XYZ; relative XYZ_normalized/.5-key-.5; center (key+.5)*.5
shared_relation_support: all old geometry-valid native work pixels; visual and loss cover whole image
offset_policy: nearest actual PTS; ties earlier; out-of-range removed; deduplicate/current excluded; self only when no usable reference
checkpoint: non-reentrant per-frame encoding/change/decoding and global attention
decoder: official epoch01 HighResContextHead; fuse after proj_norm_relu and up2; bias-free zero-initialized1x1
BN: running stats fixed eval, affine trainable
decoder_dropout: official0.1 in train, off in eval
pixel_loss: per-supervised-frame BCE + softDice epsilon1, averaged per video
block_loss: 0.1 * count-weighted BCE with soft target g/n; per-frame normalization, supervised frames only
schedule: cosine from1 to.1 over1780 update indices0..1779; recomputed exactly from checkpoint updates
selection: additional15 development macro AP each epoch1..10, earliest tie; epoch10 primary
